C1184.title: China National Cybersecurity Center Reports Multiple Supply Chain Poisoning Incidents
C1184.summary: In April 2026, the National Cybersecurity Notification Center of China detected multiple supply chain poisoning attacks targeting API development tool Apifox, Python library LiteLLM, and JavaScript HTTP library Axios.
